content: Asa Iitatethi
Asay sa7a bolla darida wode entaw macca nayti yeletidosona.
“Xoossaa nayta” geetetiya medhetethati he macca nayti mala lo77o gideysa be7idi entafe bantaw dooridaysata machidosona.
Goday, “Asas de7o immiya ta Ayyaanay asan merinaw deenna. Asi hayqeysa gidiya gisho, hizape iya laythay issi xeetanne laatama gidana” yaagis.
He wodenne hessafe guye, Xoossa nayti asa macca nayta ekin, nayti yeletida wode, wogga adussa asati sa7a bolla de7idosona. Enti beni wode olas minonne eretida asata.
Goday he wode sa7a bolla de7iya asa iitatethi daridaysanne enta wozanay ubba wode qopiyabay iita xalaala gididaysa
be7idi, ase ha sa7a bolla medhidaysan azzanis; ba wozanan daro qiirotis.
Taani ase ayis medhadina gada qiirotas. Hessa gisho, Goday, “Taani medhida ase, mehe, do7a, sa7ara gooshetiya medhetethatanne salo kafota sa7a bollafe dhaysana” yaagis.
Shin Nohey Godaa sinthan saba demmis.
Nohe
Nohe taarkey haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysa. Nohey ba wode de7iya asa giddofe Xoossaa ufaysiyanne suure asi.
Nohey Seema, Kaamanne Yaafeta geetetiya heedzu adde nayta yelis.
He wode biittay kumethi Xoossa sinthan tunis; biitta ubbay geellatethan kumis.
Xoossay ha biitta xeelliya wode sa7an de7iya asa ubbay banta ogiya tunisidi de7eysa be7is.
Hessa gisho, Xoossay Nohe haysada yaagidi kiittis; “Taani asa ubbaa dhaysana hanayis. Enta gaason biittay geellatethan kumida gisho, ase biittafe dhaysana.
Hessa gisho, mino mithafe new markabe keexa. He markabiya giddon daro qol7ata kessa. Yaatada sooranne karera made melaban meesha.
Markabiya haysada yaatada keexa; adussatethaa 300 wadha, gompaa 50 wadha, geesa 30 wadha ootha.
Markabiyas kaara medha; kaarapenne godaape giddon issi wadha gidiya bessi dooya agga. Pengiya markabiyas miye baggara kessa; markabiya heedzu pooqe kessada keexa.
“Taani salope garsan shempora de7iya medhetetha ubbaa dhaysanaw dhayo haatha yeddada ha sa7aa bolla de7iyaba ubbaa dhaysana.
Shin taani ta caaquwa neera caaqana. Neeni, ne machiw, ne adde naytanne enta macheta ekada markabiya giddo gela.
Enti neera de7on daana mela, de7oy de7iya medhetetha ubbaafe qommon qommon addenne macca nam7a nam7a oothada, markabiya giddo gelsa.
Dumma dumma qommo kafotape, dumma dumma qommo mehetapenne sa7ara gooshetiya dumma dumma qommo medhetetha ubbaafe nam7a nam7a gididi de7on daana mela neeko yo.
Qassi hintenne do7ati maanaw dumma dumma qommo miya kathi efada, markabiya giddon qola” yaagis.
Nohey ubbabaaka Xoossay kiitidaysada oothis.
